python3 -c "
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('src/codegen_support/runtime/arrays/hash_filter.rs')
t = p.read_text()
old = '''    emitter.instruction(\"mov x0, x3\");                                          // scalar value, string key
    emitter.instruction(\"mov x9, x1\");
    emitter.instruction(\"mov x1, x9\");
    emitter.instruction(\"mov x2, x2\");
    emitter.instruction(\"cbz x22, __rt_hash_filter_call\");'''
new = '''    emitter.instruction(\"mov x0, x3\");                                          // scalar value, string key: x1/x2 already hold it
    emitter.instruction(\"cbz x22, __rt_hash_filter_call\");'''
assert t.count(old) == 1
t = t.replace(old, new, 1)
old = '''    emitter.instruction(\"mov x0, x3\");                                          // scalar value, integer key
    emitter.instruction(\"mov x1, x1\");
    emitter.instruction(\"cbz x22, __rt_hash_filter_call\");'''
new = '''    emitter.instruction(\"mov x0, x3\");                                          // scalar value, integer key: x1 already holds it
    emitter.instruction(\"cbz x22, __rt_hash_filter_call\");'''
assert t.count(old) == 1
t = t.replace(old, new, 1)
p.write_text(t)
print('redundant moves removed')
